stories.title: Prisión preventiva a El Capitán Sol, clave en red de huachicol

en.title: Preventive detention for El Capitán Sol, key figure in fuel theft network
en.summary: A federal judge ordered preventive detention for former naval captain Miguel Ángel Solano Ruiz, identified as a major operator of an illegal fuel smuggling network that brought millions of liters of contraband gasoline into the country in recent years.

stories.title: Bravos se imponen a los Dodgers e igualan la serie

en.title: Braves defeat Dodgers and tie the series
en.summary: The defending champion Los Angeles Dodgers lost 3-2 to the Atlanta Braves on Sunday, evening their National League divisional series at one victory each.

stories.title: Pedro Sánchez convoca a elecciones generales anticipadas; disuelve el Parlamento tras derrota en decretos sobre vivienda

en.title: Pedro Sánchez calls early general elections; dissolves Parliament after defeat on housing decree measures
en.summary: Spain's prime minister announced early general elections following parliamentary rejection of his government's housing reform proposals, with voting to occur in November.

en.title: Sánchez to advance general elections
en.summary: After deputies rejected his housing reform proposals on Friday, Spain's prime minister announced early general elections to be held in November.

stories.title: Apagan Braves a Dodgers e igualan Serie Divisional

en.title: Braves shut out Dodgers and tie Divisional Series
en.summary: The Atlanta Braves defeated the Dodgers 3-2 in a Divisional Series game, with strong pitching and timely hitting evening the series.

stories.title: Elecciones de Brasil a segunda vuelta; presidentes de derecha festejan ventaja de Bolsonaro

en.title: Brazil's election advances to second round; right-wing presidents celebrate Bolsonaro's advantage
en.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula da Silva have advanced to Brazil's presidential runoff, prompting international statements from right-wing leaders expressing support for Bolsonaro.

stories.title: Dictan prisión preventiva de oficio a “Capitán Sol”; continuará audiencia el jueves

en.title: Preventive detention ordered for "Capitán Sol"; hearing to continue Thursday
en.summary: A preventive detention order was issued for an individual known as "Capitán Sol," with proceedings scheduled to resume on Thursday.

stories.title: Elecciones de Brasil a segunda vuelta; Bolsonaro, de seguir con el legado de su padre a sorprender a Lula en elecciones

en.title: Brazil's election advances to second round; Bolsonaro, from continuing his father's legacy to surprising Lula in elections
en.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro secured a senate seat the same year his father Jair Bolsonaro won the presidency, now advancing to a presidential runoff against Lula da Silva.

stories.title: Lula da Silva, sorprendido tras no ganar en primera vuelta de elecciones; "Brasil quiere un cambio", dice Bolsonaro

en.title: Lula da Silva surprised after not winning in first round of elections; "Brazil wants change," says Bolsonaro
en.summary: Neither candidate won Brazil's presidential election outright in the first round, leading to a scheduled second-round runoff on October 25.

stories.title: Van Lula y Bolsonaro a segunda vuelta en Brasil

en.title: Lula and Bolsonaro head to second round in Brazil
en.summary: Lula da Silva and Flavio Bolsonaro advanced to a runoff election in Brazil after the right-wing candidate received 47% in the first round.

stories.title: Brasil se va a segunda vuelta de elecciones presidenciales; Bolsonaro enfrentará a Lula

en.title: Brazil advances to second round of presidential elections; Bolsonaro will face Lula
en.summary: Bolsonaro and Lula da Silva will contest a presidential runoff scheduled for October 25.

stories.title: Dan prisión a 'Capitán Sol' por red de huachicol fiscal

en.title: Prison ordered for 'Capitán Sol' for illegal fuel smuggling network
en.summary: Miguel Ángel Solano, known as "Capitán Sol," was ordered held in preventive detention on suspicion of involvement in an illegal fuel smuggling operation.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro sorprende, supera a Lula y ambos disputarán la Presidencia de Brasil en segunda vuelta

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro surprises, surpasses Lula and both will dispute Brazil's Presidency in runoff
en.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro received 47.25% of votes compared to Lula's 44.90%, with both advancing to a second-round presidential election scheduled for October 25.

stories.title: Así es como algunas tienditas ya generan 14,500 pesos al mes por aceptar pagos con tarjeta

en.title: This is how some small shops are already generating 14,500 pesos per month by accepting card payments
en.summary: Small businesses that implemented card payment terminals in January have increased their card transaction volume by 68 percent, according to Visa data.

stories.title: Trump pone a su jefe de inteligencia al frente de la nueva fuerza para controlar la IA en Estados Unidos

en.title: Trump puts his intelligence chief in charge of new force to control AI in the United States
en.summary: Trump appointed his intelligence chief to lead a new task force responsible for developing proposals to address technology threats without hindering business innovation.

stories.title: Slim, Fernández Carbajal y Servitje, entre los empresarios que más empleos generan

en.title: Slim, Fernández Carbajal and Servitje among businessmen generating the most jobs
en.summary: José Antonio Fernández Carbajal, Carlos Slim, and Daniel Servitje are behind some of the country's largest formal employment sources.
